summary_rationale: Afcom Holdings has executed a rapid operational breakout since its December 2024 DGCA AOC, scaling revenue from ₹148.19 Cr in FY24 to ₹583.00 Cr in FY26 and ₹417.00 Cr in H1 FY27 while expanding EBITDA margins to 40% via a structural pivot from wet-leases to dry-leased Boeing 737-800BCFs and Designated Indian Carrier ATF VAT exemptions. However, capital-intensive freighter economics, ~30% PAT-to-CFO conversion (₹36 Cr CFO vs ₹122 Cr PAT in FY26), 85-day receivables, negative free cash flow (-₹171 Cr in FY26) funded by serial equity dilution, heavy Ind AS 116 lease liabilities (~₹338 Cr), and >58% reliance on cyclical charter trips classify the franchise as CYCLICAL_CONDITIONAL rather than an unconditional compounder.
